title: Ninety-Three Days

cards.text: Ordered freed March 27, 2000. Held ninety-three more days.

notes: The order was dated March 27. He was still inside. Count the days. Canon: overDetention, reversal. TITLE DEVIATES FROM THE HANDOFF: the handoff titled this 'Seventy-Seven Days'; this repository's record (locked by Michael, September 5, 2026, against the case file) derives ninety-three days from the opinion to the remittitur of June 28, 2000. Seventy-seven is the erasure (episode 005). See docs/COUNSEL_PACKET.md. All officials silhouettes (none appear).
openItems: Confirm the title and the day count with Michael and counsel: ninety-three (this repository) vs seventy-seven (the handoff).
